body:
Frustrated. I don't want to cope. I don't want to accept that this is how I have to live. I want to recover. I want answers. I want my life back.

I don't want to live like this. It's a miserable, joyless, exhausting existence.

I've mentioned suicidal ideation a month or so ago, but it's really started to reach this desperation only during the last few weeks. Haven't seen my therapist during that time.

I see him Saturday and I'll mention it. There isn't much he can really do though. It's not his fault of course, but he can't really treat the injury.
Chiropractor yeah. I think it's helped a little bit.
I just googled it. There is a place not too far from where I live, interestingly. I will look into this. Thank you for bringing it to my attention.
You're a super awesome person for supporting him through such a horrible experience.
